`954-955`: **Shells started after `/clear` can be flagged as tails because of `etime` rounding.** `ps` reports `etime` in whole seconds, and `now - c["age"]` approximates the start time. `CLEAR_SLACK` is 3 seconds, so the rounding error is small. A larger error comes from the delay between `/clear` and `cleared_at`. Line 4646 sets `cleared_at` after `_deliver` returns, and `_deliver` can return several seconds after Enter. A shell from the new session can start in that window. That shell then counts as "запущен до /clear". The consequence is limited to a false event and a dashboard mark, because no process is killed. The PR description already lists repeated tail events as an accepted limitation. No change is required in this PR.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify the pending nudge before pressing Enter**

When the initial nudge paste leaves `pending_enter` because submission failed, this branch accepts any nonempty input box as if it still contained that nudge. If the owner edits or replaces the text before the next tick, `_deliver` takes its Enter-only path and `submit()` presses Enter before checking the saved text head, unexpectedly submitting the owner's draft. The retry should confirm that the current input still matches `pending_text_head`; otherwise it should preserve the new text and discard or postpone the nudge.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve foreign drafts across later delivery retries**

When an owner replaces an undelivered nudge with a draft, `_drop_nudge` removes both reservation fields while deliberately leaving that draft in the input. The current delivery returns safely, but a saved alarm, checkpoint, or gate message is retried on a later tick; with neither `pending_enter` nor `pending_clear` remaining, `_deliver` then pastes and submits over the still-present draft. Fresh evidence beyond the prior comment is this subsequent-retry path after the state is dropped, so keep a persistent foreign-input blocker until the field is empty instead of forgetting the reservation immediately.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require the exact nudge before retrying Enter**

The retry recognizer accepts any `[0-9.]+` value in the minutes slot rather than the exact text that was originally pasted. If the owner edits only that value in an undelivered nudge—for example, changing `20` to `30`—`_nudge_is_foreign` still classifies the input as dispatcher-owned and the Enter-only retry submits the edited draft. Fresh evidence after the prior comment is this deliberately broad regex; persist and compare an exact normalized nudge value or digest instead.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reset nudge dedupe after transcript activity**

When a nudge has been sent for digest `D`, later subagent or main-transcript activity can start a new activity period without changing the pane. `note_transcript_activity()` updates `activity_at`, but never clears the saved `notified["nudge"]`; once that work becomes silent for another threshold, this guard still sees digest `D` and suppresses every subsequent nudge. Clear or version the nudge marker when transcript activity resumes so each genuinely new idle episode can receive one nudge.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clamp future mtimes before the nudge age check**

When a transcript has a future mtime—for example after a clock correction or restoring files—`now - latest` remains below the threshold until that future timestamp plus `idle_nudge_minutes`, suppressing nudges for potentially hours or indefinitely. `note_transcript_activity()` already clamps future mtimes for this reason, but this check and the equivalent precheck use the raw maximum; clamp the sampled mtimes to the current time before comparing.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear stale tail state when monitoring stops**

If `bg_tails` was populated and the wave subsequently leaves `running`—especially when it reaches a terminal phase and its window is closed—this return prevents `_watch_bg_tails()` from ever observing an empty set, while no other path removes `bg_tails` or its dedupe marker. The dashboard therefore continues showing `⚠ хвосты` for processes that may already be gone; clear the stored episode when leaving the monitored phase or make the dashboard ignore it outside that phase.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
